profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Specialties: Go, Java, Ruby, Javascript, Rails, Sinatra, JSON, XML, HTML, CSS, SQL, PostgreSQL, dynamic languages, databases

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and support internal and public-facing web application using AJAX and Ruby on Rails with an Agile, XP-based development process, including pair programming and short iterations.

Created and lead weekly informal study groups based on Javascript, including code reviews.

Helped launch a public-facing site built on Sproutcore, a Javascript MVC framework, talking to Rails backends using MongoDB and PostgreSQL. 

Lead refactoring sessions to improve existing code.

positions.title: Linux Test Engineer
positions.description: Automating and executing tests to validate Linux distribution quality on Integrity servers.  Analyzed emerging open source technologies to evaluate impact on quality standards.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Automated build and release process for large (1.5M LOC) C++ application using ClearCase and Perl.  Pioneered customer bug response process, and ensured delivered software patches were included in released product.
